faq_heading: Homes near South Delta Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the South Delta Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the South Delta Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names South Delta Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to South Delta Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are South Park Elementary (0.2 km east), Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary (1.0 km south) and du Bois-joli (1.0 km west).

How the South Delta Secondary search works

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of South Delta Secondary
